title: The exploration of chronic combined toxic mechanisms of environmental PFOA and polyethylene micro/nanoplastics on adult zebrafish (Danio rerio), using aquatic microcosm systems
authors: Wei Wu; Ruixuan Li; Zhiqiang Zhang; Gang Liu; Yingxue Sun; Chun Wang
status: included; PubMed citation and complete publisher abstract checked; programmatic verification pending
exposure: PE-MPs, PE-NPs and PFOA in aquatic microcosm systems simulating recirculating aquaculture. Exact size/doses not extracted from abstract.
endpoints: Gill/liver combined toxicity; intestinal histopathology/LPO; acetylcholine; microbiota
findings: 作者报告第7天鳃/肝协同，第28天转为拮抗。MP比NP引起更重绒毛萎缩/杯状细胞减少，共暴露进一步加重部分病理；另有组织乙酰胆碱及菌群变化。时间依赖标签与各病理终点不混为同一结果。
limitations: Method weaknesses: not assessed (read scope: abstract). Interaction reference model and independence from P05 cohorts cannot be established from abstracts; shared authors/institution and similar exposures mean not counted as proven independent replication.
locator: PubMed PMID40795757 citation; complete abstract retrieved at ScienceDirect PII S0166445X2500298X; Aquatic Toxicology287:107534,issue2025Oct,online2025-08-08.

title: Co-exposure to PFOA, PFBA and nanoplastics synergistically exacerbates neurotoxicity by impairing PINK1/Parkin-mediated mitophagy
authors: Helei Cai; Shihao Luo; Zhengrong Zhou; Feixia Chen; Jiawei Ying; Qiufang Wu; Yize Wu; Shihua Chen; Xinxin Yao; Feiqin Xie; Wenhui Xu; Ke Xu; Renyi Peng
status: included; PubMed citation and complete publisher/PubMed abstract checked; programmatic verification pending
organism: Danio rerio larvae plus human SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells; evidence streams kept distinct
stage: larval zebrafish; in vitro cell model
exposure: PFOA and PFBA alone or with nanoplastics; exact doses/particle polymer/size not extracted from abstract.
endpoints: Neural development/behavior; cellular viability, mitochondria/autophagic flux; adsorption; PINK1 overexpression/pharmacological activation
findings: NP对PFOA吸附高于PFBA，共暴露加重神经发育/行为和细胞效应。摘要称PINK1/Parkin线粒体自噬受抑，过表达/药理激活能缓解毒性；摘要未明确各救援实验属于鱼还是细胞，故不把功能验证直接归于整鱼。
limitations: Method weaknesses: not assessed (read scope: abstract). Rescue model location, whether exposures are separate binary arms or a ternary mixture, formal synergy criterion and concentrations require full text.
locator: PubMed PMID41616538 citation/Abstract; ScienceDirect PII S0160412026000607 Abstract/Highlights; Environment International208:110102,issue2026Feb,online2026-01-24.

title: Nanoplastics Decrease the Toxicity of a Complex PAH Mixture but Impair Mitochondrial Energy Production in Developing Zebrafish
authors: Rafael Trevisan; Ciara Voy; Shuxin Chen; Richard T Di Giulio
status: context only, not PFAS; publisher abstract and PMC Methods2.1–2.5, Results/Discussion excerpts/Figs1–6 and closing paragraphs checked; programmatic verification pending
exposure: 44nm PS-NP; combined10ppm particles with1%,2%,5% Elizabeth River sediment extract (36PAHs). No PFAS.
endpoints: Developmental deformity; heartbeat; fluorescent PAH uptake; EROD; OCR/mitochondrial coupling; NADH
findings: NP降低PAH累积并缓解部分畸形/血管损伤，但粒子单独或共同暴露仍影响ATP相关呼吸与线粒体耦联。只作为不同污染物的端点分离实例，不能当作PFAS拮抗证据。
limitations: Empirical checklist: external validity checked: found (author-acknowledged, closing Results/Discussion paragraph: homogeneous commercial PS spheres may not represent environmental particles). Hypothesis clarity, variable definitions, internal validity, statistical completeness and conclusion conservatism checked: none found within accessed sections, not an exhaustive appraisal; SI not checked.
locator: PMC6660138 §§2.1–2.5; Fig2 coexposure/96hpf deformities; Fig5/Results mitochondrial endpoints; final Results/Discussion paragraph on spherical particles. Environmental Science & Technology53(14):8405–8415.

title: Multi- and Transgenerational Effects of Developmental Exposure to Environmental Levels of PFAS and PFAS Mixture in Zebrafish (Danio rerio)
authors: Alex Haimbaugh; Chia-Chen Wu; Camille Akemann; Danielle N Meyer; Mackenzie Connell; Mohammad Abdi; Aicha Khalaf; Destiny Johnson; Tracie R Baker
status: context only, PFAS without plastic; publisher abstract, PMC Methods2.1–2.5 and Results3.2–3.3 excerpts checked; programmatic verification pending
exposure: PFOA7/70/700ng/L; PFOS24/240/2400ng/L; mixtures half of each individual concentration. No plastic exposure.
duration: F0≤4hpf through5dpf, daily~90%renewal; offspring followed without renewed dosing.
endpoints: Survival/morphology; behavior; RNA-seq; adult fecundity/sex ratio
findings: 低剂量早期暴露研究观察到代际行为和转录变化；F1部分繁殖/性别指标受影响。它提供长期追踪设计背景，不能说明塑料是否增强或产生共暴露跨代作用。
limitations: Empirical checklist: internal validity checked: found (author-acknowledged,§3.2.5PFOA: unusual control sex ratio may yield false positives; shutdown limited PFOAF1sex-ratio data to one cohort). Hypothesis clarity, variable definitions, external validity, statistical completeness and conclusion conservatism not checked comprehensively in accessed sections.
